name: BN4 Red Sun's ROM
now: Offered to players and read beside BN6's ROM on every platform since 5 November 2026 (shipped in 0.20.0; its research mark gone: docs/multirom/bn4.md, Turned on, whole; the New 3DS reads it where BN5's is not read, src/core/start_3ds.c); the atlas's x1 draws its maps through the engine. Mapped (src/emu/bn4.h, docs/rom/bn4.md): map lists 0x028304 (6 real-world groups) and 0x02831C (net 0x80-0x94, ACDC Area 0x90 to the Undernet and Black Earth 0x94), coordinates 0x028F04/0x028F1C, songs 0x155FF8, sprite lists 0x02793C, eToolkit 0x02009E70 (game state at +0x40), the encounter check 0x080F5370 that starts a battle, 12-byte battle records 0x08017FB8 with 4-byte entities, enemy records 0x08011888 (HP, kind, family, version, attack), chip records 0x0197EC. tools/bn4_lab.py boots it to Lan's room in romlab and starts any of its battles there. Also its 27 battle backgrounds (9-word records), its maps' Enter and LoadGFXAnims routines, its music (map lists 0x0802AFD0; net 0x12, Undernet 0x13, battle 0x14, boss 0x15), its Souls' tables (UNITE lit for WindSoul in romlab) and DarkChips, and the battle in RAM (the battle state 0x02035810, result, reward, objects); its save block moves in RAM at each change of mode. The differential's BN4 view traces its battles on the guest core in BN6's units (src/dev/xdiff_bn4_trace.c; its timer BattleState +0x40 0x02035850 and its Custom window 0x02036406 found so), compared by tools/xdiff_bn4.py: BN4's Mettaur fought twice is the same in 900 fight frames, and the control broken on purpose parts at t202.
left: Whether Blue Moon's Soul forms run in Red Sun (the forced battle drops the Soul's pseudo-chip at OK); the rest of its collision data's (six fields paired from code since: rom/bn4.md) and panels' layouts against BN6's, its numbers as BN6's (effects, sounds, the alliance words; the ids, types and CurActions mapped) (its routines for the hooks are mapped: rom/bn4.md, The differential's hooks); a New 3DS reading BN5's and BN4's ROMs together (one extra ROM its heap holds, tools/heap3ds.py).
